VAL-HOST-014.observed: Booked path PASSES: dragging the booked, unassigned party G12Hold from the side list onto empty M1 showed the banner 'Assigned G12Hold G12 to M1.', issued POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations/rsv_16fcdbe0.../assign -> 200, the canvas showed 'M1 G12Hold G. 2p Reserved 20:45' immediately and rsv_table_occupancies held (tbl_acme_m1, active=1). Arrived path FAILS: dragging the arrived, unassigned party G12Arrive onto empty M2 showed the banner 'Seated G12Arrive G12 at M2.' and POST .../rsv_893416df.../status -> 200, rsv_reservations moved to seated with seatedAt set, but no occupancy row for M2 was created, the day feed kept tableIds=[] and the canvas kept M2 'Available' (the UI claimed a table assignment that was never persisted). API-level reproduction on a fresh probe reservation (created, set arrived, then POST /status {status:seated, tableIds:[tbl_acme_p3]}) likewise created no occupancy for the requested table. Root cause: the App sends tableIds in the status transition (apps/app/app/utils/reservations/book-api.ts transitionReservationStatus, used by the floor drop and the 'Seat arrived party now' quick action) but the tenant-api service ignores it - transitionReservationStatus in apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-booking-service.ts has no tableIds handling (the route schema accepts tableIds and passes them through, the service input type and body never read them).
VAL-HOST-014.notes: Method: agent-browser CDP mouse drags did not reliably resolve HTML5 drop targets in this environment (2 attempts produced dragenter/dragend without drop), so the drags were driven by dispatching DragEvent objects with a shared DataTransfer to the app's real handlers (dragstart on the card; dragover+drop on the table; the app's onDragOver/onDrop reported defaultPrevented=true and the app itself issued POST /assign or POST /status). Verdict: the assertion names both 'upcoming' and 'arrived' parties; the booked/upcoming flow fully passes, the arrived flow seats the party without persisting the table assignment while telling the host it did, so the assertion does not meet its criteria for both named flows. sqlite evidence: rsv_table_occupancies rows for rsv_16fcdbe0 (m1 active=1) vs rsv_893416df (only the old deactivated G9-2 row).
